BULK.t: Fee schedule not loaded / wrong rate
BULK.sig: Same CPT underpaid by the same amount across many claims after Jan 1 or a contract change
fix: Pull a variance report by CPT/payer
Send one spreadsheet project to the payer rep instead of one call per claim
Get a project/reference number and track the reprocessing
BULK.ex: Example: after a 2026 rate update, 99214 at one payer is paid at the 2025 rate on 412 claims.

BULK.sig: CO-B7, CO-185 or N290 for one rendering NPI across payers or dates
fix: Pull every claim for that NPI and hold new claims
Get the effective date, including any retro date
Rebill in bulk after the payer loads the provider
BULK.ex: Example: a new LCSW was added to PNM but not affiliated with the group, so every Ohio MCO denies.

BULK.sig: Spike in CO-27, CO-109 or CO-31 for one Medicaid program after a contract change
fix: Batch re-verify eligibility
Rebill to the new plan and ask for TFL relief citing the transition notice
Track continuity-of-care auth periods
BULK.ex: Examples: DC Wellpoint exit (8/1/2026), Indiana MDwise exit (1/1/2026), Virginia Molina→Humana (7/1/2025).

BULK.sig: Identical wrong denial across many claims that the rep can't explain
fix: Escalate to the provider rep with 3–5 example claims
Ask for a project number and wait for the mass adjustment
Don't rebill (it creates duplicates)
BULK.ex: Example: a carve-out BH ASO denies residential crisis claims after a data conversion (Maryland 2025).

BULK.sig: No ERAs or acknowledgements from a payer for several days
fix: Confirm with the clearinghouse status page
Switch to the payer portal or paper
Save outage proof for TFL appeals
BULK.ex: Example: the 2024 Change Healthcare cyberattack halted claims nationwide for weeks.

BULK.sig: New CARC pattern (e.g. N769 downcodes, a Smart Edit) starts on a policy effective date
fix: Find the bulletin and effective date
Fix the charge-entry rule going forward
Appeal back-dated claims in batches with a template letter
BULK.ex: Example: Cigna R49 E/M downcodes starting October 2025.

BULK.sig: CO-197 / CO-15 concentrated in one service line or location
fix: Audit the auth list against scheduled CPTs
Request retro auth in batch where allowed
Retrain the scheduling team
BULK.ex: Example: an imaging vendor changed, and auths were obtained from the wrong benefit manager.

BULK.sig: CO-29 on claims submitted the same week
fix: Find the cause (rejections not worked, wrong payer first)
Gather 277CA proof for every claim and appeal in batch
Add an aging alert for claims within 30 days of TFL
BULK.ex: Example: Texas Medicaid's 95-day TFL caught a batch rebilled after an eligibility change.

BULK.sig: CO-22 across many members of one payer at the start of a year

Ask the payer for an auto-reprocess list after member updates

Track adjustments on the ERA (often with CARC 45/A2)

APPEALS.Medical necessity: We request reconsideration of the denial of {cpt} for date of service {dos}. The service was medically necessary for diagnosis {dx}. The enclosed records document {reason}. The service meets the criteria of {policy}. Please reprocess the claim for payment.
APPEALS.Timely filing (proof attached): The claim for date of service {dos} was denied for timely filing. Our original submission was accepted on {reason}, within the filing limit. The 277CA acceptance report is enclosed. Please reprocess.
APPEALS.Authorization obtained: The claim for {cpt} on {dos} was denied for missing authorization. Authorization {policy} was obtained before the service; a copy is enclosed. Please reprocess.
APPEALS.Bundling / modifier: {cpt} on {dos} was denied as included in another service. The service was distinct and separately identifiable: {reason}. Modifier use is supported by NCCI policy and the enclosed documentation. Please reprocess.
APPEALS.Underpayment: The claim for {cpt} on {dos} was paid below the contracted rate under {policy}. {reason} Please adjust the payment.
APPEALS.Emergency (prudent layperson): The emergency claim for {dos} was denied or downcoded based on final diagnosis. The patient presented with {reason}. Under the prudent layperson standard, coverage depends on presenting symptoms. Please reprocess.
APPEALS.Level of service (downcode): E/M {cpt} on {dos} was paid at a lower level. The documentation supports the billed level: {reason}. Please reprocess at the billed level.
APPEALS.Overpayment dispute: We dispute the overpayment request dated {reason} for {dos}. The original payment was correct under {policy}; supporting EOBs are enclosed. Please withdraw the request and hold any offset during review.
APPEALS.Transition / plan change TFL relief: The claim for {dos} was denied for timely filing after the member's plan transition ({policy}). We billed within the limit once eligibility was confirmed: {reason}. Please grant a timely-filing exception.

CALL_BASE: Please confirm the claim/line ICN, received date, adjudication date, status and exact billed service line.
Please read the adjustment GROUP code, CARC, every associated RARC and the payer-specific denial wording.
Is the claim a front-end rejection, an unprocessable claim, a pending claim, or a final adverse determination?
Which exact field, policy clause or clinical/documentation requirement caused this outcome?
Has another claim, authorization, appeal, crossover, replacement or adjustment been linked to this ICN?
What is the permitted correction/reopening/reconsideration/appeal channel for THIS determination?
What event starts the deadline, what exact deadline applies, and where is it published?
What evidence must accompany the request and how do we prove delivery/receipt?
What reference number and next follow-up date should be recorded?

Eligibility / COB: What active effective/termination dates appear for the exact DOS?
Which coverage is primary and what MSP/COB facts support that order?
Does the member need to update COB and will the claim reprocess automatically?
Coding / modifiers: Which service line, procedure, diagnosis pointer, modifier and edit triggered the decision?
Is there a documented separate or repeat service, and does an NCCI/payer edit permit it?
Does the corrected code/modifier accurately reflect the original record?
Authorization / referral: Which authorization type, CPT, units, provider, site and approved dates are on file?
Does payer allow a retrospective authorization or administrative reconsideration, and under which conditions?
Timely filing: What original filing deadline and payer-received date were used?
Do you recognize prior payer acknowledgments, 277CA acceptance, exception or secondary EOB as proof?
Is this a filing-limit exception request rather than an appeal of an unappealable Medicare FFS timely-filing denial?
Payment / offsets: What is the check/EFT trace, payment issue date, ERA destination and deposit status?
Which prior ICN/overpayment notice and adjustment cycle generated the offset?
How do we reconcile the gross adjudication with net payment and PLB entries?
Medical necessity / records: What exact coverage policy and effective version was applied on this DOS?
Which clinical elements are missing and where can records be submitted securely?
Was the decision made from a complete chart or a document request that was not fulfilled?
